Cancellation around the outer step cannot interrupt those publications, and the original reset wrapper had no cancellation check. Controlled native/event tests through the stock adapter/server/client showed that the old e-stop returned completed, latched=true and safe_state_achieved=true before an in-flight step sent three further commands or reset sent 248 further commands. Reset then returned completed despite being listed cancelled. The old hold also returned held=true with cached nonzero velocities: real_env.py:57-64 does not require fresh samples, and Recorder at robot_utils.py:105-111 merely updates cached arrays. Reset completed without any operator envelope and with +/-0.1 rad arm bounds while publishing START_ARM_POSE including -0.96 and 1.16 rad (constants.py:16).
